tools.name: gitlab_merge_requests
tools.description: Merge requests, most recently updated first, with state, branches, reviewers and whether each can merge. owner, name and host come from the git remote.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. gitlab.acme.dev.

tools.name: gitlab_mr_files
tools.description: The files a merge request changes, with status and line counts. Name paths for their diffs; a long diff comes in parts, with a note on the rest.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. gitlab.acme.dev.

paths.description: Only these files, each with its patch.

offset.description: Patch line to start from, from 0. The note gives the next one.

lines.description: Patch lines to return. Default 400, at most 1000; a patch also stops at 32 KB.

tools.name: gitlab_comments
tools.description: What people wrote on a merge request or an issue, oldest first. Merge requests and issues are numbered apart, so say which.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. gitlab.acme.dev.

number.description: The merge request's !number or the issue's #number.

tools.name: gitlab_issues
tools.description: A project's issues, most recently updated first, 30 to a page, with labels and assignees.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. gitlab.acme.dev.

tools.name: gitlab_pipelines
tools.description: Recent pipelines, newest first, with status, conclusion, branch and the merge request each ran for.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. gitlab.acme.dev.

tools.name: gitlab_pipeline
tools.description: One pipeline with its jobs, named stage / job, and their status, to see which job failed.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. gitlab.acme.dev.

tools.name: gitlab_job_log
tools.description: The end of one CI job's log, without colour codes. Start with the default tail or grep for the error. truncated means earlier lines were left out.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. gitlab.acme.dev.

tail.description: Lines from the end, after grep. Default 200, at most 2000.

grep.description: Only lines containing this, ignoring case.
